senses.gloss:
लेप् €1 P. (लेपते)
—1 To go, move.
—2 To worship.

लेपः [लिप्-घञ्]
—1 Smearing, plastering, anointing; भूशुद्धिर्मार्जनात् … … … सेकादुल्लेखनाल्लेपात् Y. 1. 188.
—2 An unguent, ointment, salve.
—3 A plaster in general (such as white-wash, mortar &c.).
—4 The wipings of the hand (or the remnants of the food sticking to the
 hand), after offering funeral oblations to the first three ancestors (पितृ,
 पितामह and प्रपितामह), (these wipings being offered to the three
 ancestors after the great-grand-father; i. e. to paternal ancestors
 in the 4th, 5th and 6th degrees); लेपभाजश्चतुर्थाद्याः पित्राद्याः पिण्डभागिनः.
—5 A spot, stain, defilement, pollution.
—6 Moral impurity, sin.
—7 Food.
—8 Smearing with clay; L. D. B.
.━{@Comp.@}: लेपकरः, लेपभागिन्, लेपभुज्

लेपः + -भागिन्, -भुज् m. a paternal ancestor in the 4th, 5th and 6th
 degree; तेषु दर्भेषु तं हस्तं निमृज्याल्लेपभागिनाम् Ms. 3. 216.

लेपः + -भागिन्, -भुज् m. a paternal ancestor in the 4th, 5th and 6th
 degree; तेषु दर्भेषु तं हस्तं निमृज्याल्लेपभागिनाम् Ms. 3. 216.

—1 A plasterer, mason, white-washer.
—2 One who moulds or models.

लेपनः + .{@-नम्@}
—1 Anointing, smearing, plastering; भूशुद्धिः … … गृहं मार्जनलेपनात् Y. 1. 188.
—2 A plaster, an ointment.
—3 Mortar, white-wash.
—4 Flesh.
लेपिन् a. Smearing or covering with. ━m. A plasterer, brick-layer.

लेप्य a.
—1 To be plastered, smeared &c.
—2 Moulded, modelled; शैली दारुमयी लौही लेप्या लेख्या च सैकती (प्रतिमाष्टविधा)
 Bhāg. 11. 27. 12.

लेप्य + .{@-प्यम्@}
—1 Plastering, smearing.
—2 Moulding, modelling, making models.
.━{@Comp.@}: लेप्यकृत्, लेप्यनारी, लेप्यस्त्री

लेप्य + -कृत् m.
—1 a model-maker.
—2 a brick-layer.
लेप्य + -नारी a moulded figure of a woman.
लेप्य + -स्त्री a woman covered with unguents or perfumed ointments.
